scope: Shared Mantle operation layer / explicit recorded-call plan update; static documentation evidence only

current_contracts.device_ownership: one owning Mantle Device/domain per array, many graph-node uses
current_contracts.eager: standard Julia GPU array interfaces; no extra public numerical device argument
current_contracts.implementation: one shared Mantle definition/recipe, reused by eager and recorded frontends
current_contracts.capabilities: one shared selector intersects enabled hardware/compiler semantics, shapes/layouts/aliases/workspace and execution requirements; compares eligible candidates using performance evidence
current_contracts.returns: per-definition contract, not ! spelling or an every-call-future rule
current_contracts.snapshots: standard blocking Array(a); recorded call!(target,Array,a) future; established Readback(previous_future) replay request only
current_contracts.cpu_callbacks: explicit HostCall during replay; no automatic CPU/eager fallback for unknown functions
current_contracts.backend_boundary: native facts, intrinsic lowering and command encoding; no algorithm/selection/scheduling duplication

julia.limitations: Syntax/name/pattern checks only; no Mantle import, method execution or native/runtime qualification

historical_evidence: Original review reports and before-edit archives retained; earlier validation artifacts only prove their recorded inputs
implementation_status: open; F110–F114 and related phase/native/consumer gates require replacement implementation
